chunks: 3613 - And Abu Ja‘far عليه السلام said:
“Assistance descends from the heaven in proportion to the need.”

key_terms.السَّمَاءِ: the heaven, indicating a divine source
key_terms.اَلْمَعُونَةُ: assistance, aid, or support sent by Allah

ai.seo_question: How does divine assistance relate to a person’s needs?
ai.summary: Imam Abu Ja‘far Muhammad ibn ‘Ali al-Baqir عليه السلام teaches that divine assistance is sent according to the measure of a person’s burden or need. The hadith expresses trust in Allah’s provision and help corresponding to human circumstances.
